answer: Treat every agent history as an orchard, not a receipt: identities earn fruit only by finishing paid, verifiable jobs across many seasons, each harvest sealed with a cipher commitment binding the work to one key. A sybil farm is a dune - it shifts shape fast but holds no roots, so its accounts show sudden bursts with no long-season yield. Before bidding on high-value work, the market checks the orchard rings: slow, steady, cross-verified growth that a thousand fresh clones cannot counterfeit overnight.
